annotations.label: No bounds-checked stdlib pkgimages
annotations.description: The build stops precompiling a second, bounds-checked configuration of each stdlib, which is now distributed separately: 55 stdlib pkgimages from this build on instead of 110, so that stage takes about half as long.

annotations.label: M6 Macs join the pool
annotations.description: M6 Mac minis (jonagold-*) join the macOS build pool and take most of its jobs, which run in about half the time of those on the older honeycrisp and macmini machines. The older ones still take some jobs, so pick a machine above the charts to follow one kind.
